text.p: Italian bond futures ended firmer in line with other European debt markets, driven up by belief that the single European currency will start on schedule and that Italy, Spain and Portugal will be founder members.

Traders said this was the sentiment which began on forex markets and quickly spread to bond futures, despite early falls on a leftwing win in French elections and the Bundesbank/Bonn gold reserves row.
The Btp yield spread over the benchmark 10-year Bund narrowed to 133 basis points during the afternoon. "Btps followed the improvement on the exchange rate," one trader said.
